text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Good Mile-ning! Let's charge forward 
together on the path to becoming the 
ultimate miler!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... About that... I was thinking of 
trying my best in long distance races from 
now on...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't get results in the mile anyway. 
So... ...I'm sorry, Gran-chan.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, okay! Got it! Good luck in the 
long mile! I'll be cheering for you!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...Being a miler is super fun, though.
